transformMentalHealthJourney: Apni mental health journey start karo - ek baar mein ek step.
signUpItsFree: Sign up karo, bilkul free hai!
startHealingJourney: Apni healing journey start karo - aapki kahani yahan se shuru hoti hai.
question: Question
personalizedAssessment: Yeh aapka personalized emotional intelligence assessment hai
excellentEmotionalBalance: Bahut accha emotional balance aur logon ke saath behavior
generallyHealthy: Normal tarah se accha, thoda improvement chahiye
averageNeedsImprovement: Average; mushkilon se nipatne mein improvement chahiye
lowBehaviouralAdaptability: Kam flexibility; khud ko samajhne aur logon se baat karne par dhyan do
continueNurturing: Aapki emotional samajh bahut acchi hai. Isse banaye rakho!
goodFoundation: Aapki foundation acchi hai, bas kuch jagah improvement chahiye. Un jagahon par dhyan do jahan aap behtar hona chahte ho.
roomForGrowth: Feelings ko sambhalne aur logon se baat karne mein improvement ki jagah hai. Improvement ke liye madad lo.
needsAttention: Is par dhyan dene ki zarurat hai. Madad lekar khud ko samajhne aur feelings ko sambhalne ki koshish karo.
takePreScreenerTests: Hamare aasan tests karo aur apni report payo. Yeh aapko batayega ki aapki journey kahan se shuru honi chahiye.
clinicallyValidatedTests: Doctors dwara check kiye gaye tests
getAnswersUnder3Minutes: 3 minute mein apne sawalon ke jawab payo. Hamare tests se apne mental health ko samjho aur aage kya karna hai, yeh jano.
